tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search this publication's articles by keyword. Returns the best-matching titles, dates, canonical URLs, and short summaries.

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: List the most recently published articles from this publication.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full clean text of one article by its slug (the last path segment of an article URL).

tools.name: popular_content
tools.description: The most-read / most-requested articles, ranked by how often AI assistants have actually fetched them. Use for "what is your most popular article", "top reads", or to recommend what to read.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search this site's content. Returns matching documents (id, title, url); pass an id to `fetch` for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of one document by the id returned from `search`.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
